description: Horaires temps-réel du réseau Car Jaune (GTFS-RT) is a dataset listed in Portail Open Data de La Réunion, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Régional de La Réunion. Les horaires en temps réel du réseau interurbain Car Jaune à La Réunion au format GTFS-RT sont accessibles à cette URL: (URL stable data.gouv.fr: ). Coverage: La Réunion. The portal files it under Transports et déplacements. Its keywords are GTFS-RT, horaire, Car Jaune. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-regionreunion-com-portal.
